newsitem.title: GREECE: Eurobank acquires Credit Lyonnais' retail banking.
newsitem.headline: Eurobank acquires Credit Lyonnais' retail banking.

text.p: Eurobank said it acquired the retail banking arm of Credit Lyonnais Greece SA after signing the deal on Tuesday.
This will mean Credit Lyonnais' five branches -- two in Athens, two in Thessaloniki and one in Larissa -- will join Eurobank's network.
Following the merger with Interbank, Eurobank's Greek network will now number 40 branches , it said.
Credit Lyonnais will continue to operate in Greece in the areas of shipping, corporate and private banking. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
